sobreMi.texto: IT Infrastructure, Linux and Technical Support professional with hands-on experience in Windows, Linux, networking, web infrastructure, VPS hosting, hardware and systems administration. I have deployed and managed Linux servers, VPS instances, websites, self-hosted services, cloud services and game servers, configuring domains, DNS, HTTPS, SSL/TLS certificates, Cloudflare, GitHub, WordPress and cPanel. I also have practical experience with networking, SSH, Samba, OpenWRT, Ubiquiti, hardware diagnostics, server monitoring, remote administration and Windows/Linux integration. My approach focuses on solving real technical problems through research, official documentation, hands-on experimentation and AI-assisted workflows while applying security best practices, backups, documentation and data protection.

items.texto: Systems administration and hands-on learning in enterprise infrastructure. Labs involving SaltStack automation, Docker containers, Microsoft Azure, and embedded Linux builds with Yocto. Troubleshooting and technical documentation.

Infrastructure design and administration for personal projects and clients: Linux and Windows servers, networking, hosting, VPS, Cloudflare, development tools, automation, streaming and AI integration. Projects documented on GitHub.
Vehicle diagnostics using OBD-II and DTC interpretation, sensor and actuator testing, ECU analysis and automotive wiring diagrams. Repairs and systematic troubleshooting for customers.
Managed Debian servers via SSH for an e-commerce platform: website deployment, hosting, domains, DNS, HTTPS, SSL/TLS certificates, performance, incident response and technical SEO.
